resources.string: Modules add things to Mochy: new places to play songs from, new lyrics and new looks. Turn one off and everything it added goes away with it, from Audio Quality too.
Add a module from the catalog or from a link
A module is a service someone else runs. Mochy only asks it for songs, lyrics or a look, and it can\'t touch anything else in the app.
That doesn\'t look like a link. It should start with https://
Couldn\'t reach that link. Check it and your connection, then try again.
That link answered, but it isn\'t a module Mochy can use.
Couldn\'t load the catalog. Check your connection and open this again.
Nothing in the catalog yet. Paste a module\'s link above to add it.
It starts switched off, so nothing changes until you turn it on from its page.
You already have this one. Adding it again updates it to what the link says now.
Signed in to %1$s. It\'s on now.
Sign in first, then turn it on here.
Songs play from %1$s when it has them, in the order set under Audio Quality.
Its lyrics join your lyrics sources.
Its look replaces your look settings while it\'s on, and yours come back when you turn it off.
Runs every step on this phone with “%1$s”: finding the song, opening the stream, and decoding the start of it, muted.
Runs every step on this phone with “%1$s”: finding the song, opening the stream, getting a license from this phone\'s Widevine, and decoding the start of it, muted.
Everything works. With %1$s on, play anything and a toast says where each song comes from.
Not available: lossless, Dolby Atmos and Apple\'s Spatial mix (Apple only encodes those for its own DRM, FairPlay) and downloads (web players get no offline licenses).
CD-quality FLAC when the service has it.
24-bit FLAC when there\'s one. If this phone can\'t decode it, the CD-quality one plays.
Around 320 kbps, a lot less data.
The usual mix, lossless when the service has it.
The Dolby Atmos mix when the service has one. It isn\'t lossless, and a phone that can\'t decode it gets stereo.

Tap YouTube Music to turn it on or off, or a module to open its page. Drag a handle to change the order: each song plays from the first one that\'s on and has it. Modules you\'ve switched off aren\'t listed here.
